description: Opus BB unit B24: Utility Umbrella under Magic Room. Blissey sets Magic Room in the setup turn (its onFieldStart runs every item's End, suppressed: every holder ignores its item). In Pelipper's rain, Castform holds an umbrella and keeps its base forme (no WeatherChange ran). Weavile, holding another umbrella, Tricks Castform: both `takeItem` Ends are suppressed (Magic Room), and the new umbrella's Start on Castform, which ignores it, runs WeatherChange: Forecast sees the rain, Castform-Rainy.
